result.topic_en: A column of logarithmic calculations for an angle A = 1°48'30", followed by an attempt to solve the differential equation x - y dx/dy = α(dy/dx)^2 + β(dy/dx)^4 by power and parametric series, with sketches of crossing rays.

methods.what: Logarithmic computation (adding/subtracting log values) for angle A
Differential equation relating x - y dx/dy to even powers of slope
Trial power-law solution y = Ax^n substituted into the equation
Parametric series ansatz for x and y in a parameter t
methods.quote:
$y = At^3 + Bt^5 + Ct^7$
$x = att + bt^4 + ct^6$

methods.what: Parametric solution with t as slope parameter, giving x - y/t as even series in t
methods.quote:
$x = 3\alpha tt + 5\beta t^4 + 7\gamma t^6$
$y = 2\alpha t^3 + 4\beta t^5 + 6\gamma t^7$
$x - \frac{y}{t} = \alpha tt + \beta t^4 + \gamma t^6$
